I am old now, 87 years, and my hands are not as strong as they once were. This small maize plot near the house I have farmed for many, many seasons, the same way my mother taught me. I have no money for the fertilizer from the shop — that is for the big farmers with cash. I will put the manure from my few goats and chickens like I always do, save seed from last harvest, and my daughter and grandchildren will help me with the weeding.
